name: UsbMsc
description: FreeInk USB Mass Storage: exposes the SD card to a host PC as a USB drive. Services host sector reads/writes against the esp-idf card handle with a background write-back task, and handles the USB PHY teardown needed to return the port to the serial/JTAG console. Requires native SDMMC and a USB-OTG capable target (FREEINK_CAP_USB_MSC).
keywords: usb, msc, mass storage, sd, sdmmc
